body: ClassKit does not currently expose permanent product deletion. The level-100 platform-admin action admin.products.truncate invokes class-kit-admin-products truncate_product with an exact product_key. It deletes product-scoped classes, schedules, schedule skips, templates, registrations, attendance participants, membership ledger/grants/types, access entries, non-admin product users, and non-baseline user-role assignments. It deliberately preserves the product row, allowed origins, auth redirects, product roles and permissions, unrelated products, and restores the invoking admin as the sole active manager baseline. Product admin UIs must require exact product-key confirmation before calling it.
creator: operator
rationale: This destructive safety boundary is durable, implementation-backed, regression-tested, and required to answer the fixed Class Kit Project Memory dogfood question accurately.
target_hint: Admin product truncation, preserved configuration, and exact-key confirmation
title: Platform product truncation contract
